context: Asuka lectures on power and truth.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: philosophy lecture; vocabulary (権力/常識/真実/発想/要因) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 権力は、真実を曲げることがあります。
lines.en: Power can sometimes bend the truth.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 真実は、どう守るんですか?
lines.en: How do we protect the truth?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 常識を疑う発想が、真実を守ります。
lines.en: The idea of doubting common sense protects truth.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 常識は、いつも正しいんですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 常識が、誤りの要因になることもあります。
lines.en: Common sense can be a factor in error too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新しい発想は、どう生まれますか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 権力に流されない姿勢が、要因です。
lines.en: A stance not swayed by power is a factor.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 真実を求める発想、大事ですね。
lines.en: The mindset of seeking truth matters.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
